component.name: Kirisame
component.summary: Visual novel library and player for KiriKiri and ONScripter games

description.p: Kirisame is a Linux-native visual novel player for KiriKiri2 / KiriKiriZ games (XP3 archives), based on the Kirikiroid2 port. It also bundles onsyuri (ONScripter-yuri) to run ONScripter games. A GTK4 game library fronts both engines: covers, metadata, playtime stats and cloud saves in one place, no Wine needed.

ul.li: Game library with a responsive cover grid, search, sorting and play-state filters; double-click a cover to play
Automatic engine detection when adding games (KiriKiri / ONScripter)
VNDB / TouchGal metadata: cover art, titles, description, rating, developer, release date, tags
Automatic playtime tracking with per-game and weekly statistics
WebDAV cloud saves (Nextcloud, InfiniCLOUD, …) with automatic upload on exit

description.p: First Flathub-oriented release notes: ONScripter engine support via bundled onsyuri, automatic engine detection when adding games, playtime pie charts, responsive cover grid, clearable cover cache.
